title: Segmentation fault when opening nvim-cmp floating window

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
### Neovim version (nvim -v)

NVIM v0.8.0-dev-879-g803b7a774

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

N/A

### Operating system/version

Linux

### Terminal name/version

st

### $TERM environment variable

st-256color

### Installation

build from repo

### How to reproduce the issue

[nvim-cmp](https://github.com/hrsh7th/nvim-cmp) completion window produces segfault. Other floating windows don't exhibit the same behavior. See https://github.com/neovim/neovim/issues/19823#issuecomment-1219126192 to reproduce without nvim-cmp.

### Expected behavior

No segfault.

### Actual behavior

`hl_def` in `update_window_hl()` is `NULL`:
